Takedown.name: Takedown / Javelin Toss
Takedown.tooltip:
Cougar Form: Nidalee's next Attack deals @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:TotalTakedownDamage@ plus @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:TakedownDamageAmp@% per 1% missing Health magic damage.

If the enemy was Hunted, deals 30% increased damage.

uman Form: Nidalee throws her javelin, dealing @HumanMinimumDamage@ magic damage, increased up to [{HumanMaximumDamage} magic damage] based on distance flown.

JavelinToss.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
JavelinToss.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Human Form:</keywordMajor> Nidalee throws her javelin, dealing <magicDamage>@HumanMinimumDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, increased up to <magicDamage>@HumanMaximumDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> based on distance flown.

PrimalSurge.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
PrimalSurge.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Human Form:</keywordMajor> Nidalee restores <healing>@TotalHealing@ Health</healing> increased up to <healing>@MaxHealing@</healing> based on missing Health and grants them <attackSpeed>@BonusAS*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for @ASDuration@ seconds.

AspectOfTheCougar.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
AspectOfTheCougar.tooltip:
Passive: While in Human Form, applying Hunted refreshes this Ability's Cooldown.

Human Form: Nidalee transforms into Cougar Form, gaining melee Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.

Cougar Form: Nidalee transforms into Human Form, gaining ranged Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.

damageRefs.context: Cougar Form: Nidalee claws at enemies in front of her, dealing [{spell.AspectOfTheCougar:TotalSwipeDamage} magic damage] .

Swipe.name: Swipe / Primal Surge
Swipe.tooltip: <keywordMajor>Cougar Form:</keywordMajor> Nidalee claws at enemies in front of her, dealing <magicDamage>@spell.AspectOfTheCougar:TotalSwipeDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

Bushwhack.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
Bushwhack.tooltip:
Human Form: Nidalee places an invisible trap for 2 minutes. When an enemy walks over it, they are dealt @DamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second for @DotDuration@ seconds.

@MaxTraps@ traps may be active at once.

NidaleePassiveHunt.name: Prowl
NidaleePassiveHunt.tooltip:
Nidalee starts with a rank in Aspect of the Cougar.

Nidalee gains @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS@% Move Speed for 2 seconds when entering Brush, increased to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS*3@% Move Speed while moving toward enemy champions.

Hitting champions or jungle monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack marks them as Hunted for 4 seconds. While an enemy is Hunted, they are revealed with True Sight and Nidalee gains @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS@% Move Speed, increased to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS*3@% Move Speed toward the Hunted enemy.

Pounce.name: Pounce / Bushwhack
Pounce.tooltip:
Cougar Form: Nidalee pounces, dealing @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:TotalPounceDamage@ magic damage to enemies surrounding where she lands. Killing a unit in Cougar Form reduces this Ability's Cooldown to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PounceCooldown@ seconds.

Pouncing at a Hunted enemy can be done from a greater distance and reduces this Ability's Cooldown to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PounceCooldown@ seconds.
